resource_window.scope: Matched request envelope plus one-second padding, rounded outward to 100ms samples. CPU includes background work/traffic and TLS; not an isolated compression CPU cost. RSS is sampled and shared across variants in long-lived processes.

server_metadata.scope: Temporary gzip for successful entry GETs; request/response headers removed before journal output.

limitations: One Internet runner, batched variant order rather than randomized adjacent calls. Server windows include background work. No packet trace. No independent per-variant server RSS peaks; same long-lived processes and pools. HTTP body bytes exclude transport headers.
